title: Puzzle Late
user: Daily-puzzle fans who finish a puzzle quickly and want more original, browser-native challenges available immediately without copying a newspaper game’s archive.

evidence.quote_or_summary: A Connections fan says that after finishing the daily puzzle 'that's it until tomorrow' and built a replay archive with optional hints to solve that limitation.
An itch.io discussion argues for a true browser experience with 'no install, no account, just a tab'; replies also expose the need to budget for low-memory machines.

recurrence: One player-facing thread documents the post-daily shortage; a separate browser-distribution discussion reinforces that immediate play and broad device support are valuable but require discipline.
current_workaround: Replay a proprietary game through unofficial archives, wait until tomorrow, install a puzzle app, or browse a large unsorted puzzle site.
incumbents_and_gap: NYT Games and Puzzmo create daily habits, while archive sites often depend on another publisher’s content. The unresolved gap is a fully original, small puzzle anthology that is intentionally playable after the daily is done.
smallest_useful_product: A zero-account browser anthology of 40 original 'late puzzles': each is a five-minute visual deduction about timing, shadows, or routes, with two optional non-spoiler nudges and a daily featured shelf. A completed run unlocks a tiny hand-drawn ending card; puzzle order adapts only locally. Non-goals: reproducing any newspaper puzzle, scraped archives, user chat, or 3D assets.
success_measure: At least 45% of visitors complete two different puzzles in one session and fewer than 10% leave before opening a puzzle on a low-end mobile performance test.
monetization: one-time — a complete original anthology has a clear paid value while the first five puzzles can remain free and ad-free.
constraints: All puzzles, wording, and visual language must be original; no use of NYT or other publisher content; keep asset budget below a modest mobile page-load target and preserve accessibility labels.
why_distinct: It solves the after-daily moment with original authored micro-puzzles rather than an unauthorized replay site or generic puzzle generator.
